title: Wandering Travelers
description: Adds Wandering Traders Trader Variants to Fresh Animations
body:
Adds a bunch of unique Wandering Trader Variants that can spawn in your world!

This Pack was inspired by [More Merchants](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/more-merchants) by [MincraftEinstein](https://modrinth.com/user/MincraftEinstein)

**_!!WARNING!!_** THIS TEXTURE PACK REQUIRES [FRESH ANIMATIONS](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations) AND ITS DEPENDENCIES ( [EMF](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features) and [ETF](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures)) IN ORDER TO WORK! I plan to release a version that doesn't require fresh animations on a later date.
